seg.seg_rev_note: Two segments: Freight Group and Transit Group. Segment sales = sales to external customers as published. Note: Wabtec later reclassified some businesses between segments (e.g., Q1-14 10-Q shows Q1-13 Freight $313.7m / Transit $301.8m vs. originally reported $305.9m / $309.6m); figures here are as originally reported.
seg.notes: Q4 segment income from operations DERIVED = 10-K full-year segment note minus 9M segment note in Q3-14 10-Q (not published for Q4). FY segment sales in 10-K equal 9M + Q4 release figures, so bases are consistent. No Q4 product-line sales published (10-K gives full year only). No Q4 sales attribution published (10-K gives full-year bridge only). Backlog from the 10-K Item 1 backlog table (total and expected delivery next year).

ngaap.guidance: Issued 2015 guidance for EPS of about $4.05, with revenues expected to increase about 10%.
